children: 1inch has deployed its full product stack on Monad, live from day one of the network. The rollout includes intent-based swaps with no gas fees and MEV protection, cross-chain entry without a bridge, native USDC through CCTP, and the Aqua aggregation running from launch, per the Canonical Event announcement.

The deployment expands 1inch's addressable user base and usage-driven value accrual to a new high-performance EVM chain. Traders on Monad gain intent-based swaps, MEV protection, and bridgeless cross-chain entry, while Aqua aggregation is available from the start rather than added later. Markets may reassess 1INCH on the potential for cross-chain volume growth originating from Monad. One limitation applies to that thesis: the deployment is an integration, and no token-economic change accompanies it, so any repricing would rest on expected usage rather than altered supply or fee-distribution mechanics.
